content.about: Bolivia is a landlocked country in South America, with the Andes and the Amazon. Salar de Uyuni becomes a giant mirror when wet. La Paz is the highest seat of government. Lake Titicaca lies on its border.

standout.text: Salar de Uyuni is the largest salt flat in the world.

didYouKnow: La Paz is the highest seat of government.
Lake Titicaca is a high navigable lake.
